crime: During free time, a girl often brought worn clothes and mending supplies to a lounge table. The girl chose the garment, patch, thread, and each step; {WITCH_NAME} did exactly as directed. The girl got neatly mended clothes and company, while the witch got an afternoon without decisions.

One afternoon, the girl slipped while cutting a patch, leaving a short, shallow cut across one palm. {WITCH_NAME} stared at the blood. Asked why, the witch admitted that the first thought was how easy it would be if the bleeding never stopped.

The girl pulled the injured hand away, saying there would be no more private afternoons with someone who thought that way and that the others would be warned. The girl wrapped the bleeding palm and left the lounge.

Another girl met the injured girl at the lounge door, took the injured girl straight to the medical room, and heard what had happened, what {WITCH_NAME} had thought, and the warning. The second girl pressed a thick fold of cloth over the shallow cut and never left the injured girl's side. The second girl saw no new injury, and the cut remained shallow. Yet as the injured girl weakened, blood soaked straight through the cloth at the same rate. The injured girl died that evening.

The death first looked like a freak medical accident caused by the girl's own scissors; {WITCH_NAME} had touched neither the scissors nor the wound. Ordinary bleeding slows under pressure and blood loss. This flow did not. The victim's account placed the witch alone with the victim as the bleeding began. The witch had used Sealed Course on that active flow, fixing its direction and speed. Nothing could stop or slow it until the victim's blood was gone, so the victim bled to death.
fields.epitaph: She let the cruel thought run its course; the water left her behind.
execution: A transparent tank encloses the execution stand. The witch is bound upright to the stand inside the tank. Water pours in and rises around her. The restraints hold her still as the current moves past her body. Water covers her mouth and nose, enters her lungs, and drowns her. The tank remains full, her corpse held upright beneath the surface.

magic.name: Sealed Course
magic.text: She can make any visible liquid already flowing keep its current direction and speed.
